title: 다섯 줄의 앵콜
suno_analysis_sp: K-Rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted power chords and syncopated riffs. A high-pitched male tenor provides aggressive, belted vocals with occasional grit. The drums feature a driving backbeat with frequent crash cymbal accents and rapid double-kick patterns. A distorted bass guitar follows the guitar riffs closely. The tempo is 165 BPM in the key of E minor. The production is polished with modern compression and slight saturation on the vocals. Lead guitar fills use wah-wah and rapid alternate picking.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[feedback swell, rapid drum fill]
[distorted electric guitar riff, driving drums]
(Yeah!)

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted guitar, bass locks with kick]
아무도 끝내지 못해 [snare roll]
새벽을 마주하며 다가서 [crash cymbal]
땀이 기타 넥을 적셨어
관객이 앵콜을 외쳐 [guitar slide]
기타를 다시 잡았어
마지막 곡이야
이 곡으로 끝이야! [vocal grit]

[Chorus]
[full band, open power chords]
인트로를 시작했어
코러스에 들어서 [lead guitar fill]
(Yeah!)
